svg.title: Signing in to the OVPCASSS Paperless PAR
svg.desc: A browser window showing the sign-in page: a card with the university email and password fields and a navy Sign in button, with a pointer about to press it. Beside the window stand a brass padlock with its key in the lock, an envelope with a verified seal under a university ID card, a desk tray of report folders, and a potted plant.
